review_goal: Determine the defensible production handling for ORI CA0012100 and whether the BART policing row should be localized to Alameda County, Oakland, another county/place proxy, or a custom BART transit-system footprint.
bottom_line: Treat CA0012100 as a custom BART system-and-property overlap, not Alameda County and not Oakland. The county-tagged ORI name is an administrative roster slice of a multi-county transit police system. Until production supports a custom BART footprint, keep the row broad overlap rather than collapsing it to a false county or place proxy.
